Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today. Attaching the MAP draft (MAP_Draft_v2.pdf) and a first-pass integration spec (Integration_Specs.xlsx). Per our discussion, I pulled out the integration-build milestone into its own section so we can lock owners and dependencies.

Top-level ask: please confirm your internal owners and target "acceptance" dates so we can include that in the MAP and align Redwood delivery dates.

Proposed MAP milestone (Integration build plan) — please confirm/edit:
- SDK integration (mobile + server): Owner: Redwood (Dev Patel) / Acme review: Priya — Target: 2027-03-24
- Streaming & low-latency inference (client-side streaming + server batching): Owner: Redwood (Rishi Malhotra) / Acme infra: Samir Patel — Target: 2027-03-28
- Tool calling & secure connector (document/tool access from Acme systems): Owner: Acme (Samir) / Redwood support: Dev — Target: 2027-03-21
- Structured outputs & schema validation (JSON schema/v1): Owner: Acme PM (Priya) / Redwood: Lauren — Target: 2027-03-18

Dependencies called out in the spec: staging API key, dedicated capacity window for load tests (we requested a Dedicated burst slot during integration), and signed SOW for dev effort. I added those under "dependencies" in Integration_Specs.xlsx.

Next steps:
1) Alex/Priya confirm or edit owners and the three-week target dates above
2) If owners/targets look good, we'll add them to the MAP and send for mutual sign-off
3) Dev/Rishi/Lauren please review the spec and confirm capacity/estimates by EOD Friday (2027-02-12)

Attachments: MAP_Draft_v2.pdf, Integration_Specs.xlsx

Thanks —

- Targets: we need to push the overall "acceptance" to the end of March on our side due to a scheduled sprint cutover. Proposed acceptance target: 2027-03-31. We can still do intermediate integrations earlier (SDK + schema) as you listed.

Happy to jump on a short call next week to lock dates if that helps.
